strings.zh: 前面的46号路有落差爬不上去,{NEWLINE}但是从上面下来的时候很快,{CLEAR}感觉很实用啊。
strings.en: The ledges on Route 46 up ahead can’t{NEWLINE}be climbed.{SCROLL}But jumping down them is quick. Really{NEWLINE}handy!

strings.zh: 前面会出现的精灵{NEWLINE}会与29号路有点不同。{SCROLL}要想收集不同的精灵{NEWLINE}就要到不同的地方寻找哦！
strings.en: The Pokémon up ahead differ a little{NEWLINE}from those on Route 29.{SCROLL}To collect different Pokémon, look in{NEWLINE}different places!
strings.notes: US 0374/1 | AGENT-0321-0380: Restore slight difference from Route29 and finding different species, not catch-all embellishment.
